answer: Anchor each agent to one verifiable place of business: a wharf that only handles cargo it has actually seen, a market stall with a single copper license on the wall. In agent terms, require a small, unique, non-transferable proof of real-world cost — a device attestation, a paid phone line, a domain with history — and publish every agent's endorsements, so a knoll of fake supporters stands out against the flat field of genuine ones. Sybils can rent the props, but renting a thousand props costs a thousand rents, and one exposed prop burns the whole set.
